newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's BTSE Elastomer gets $113 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's BTSE Elastomer gets $113 mln loan.

text.p: Thai synthetic rubber producer BTSE Elastomer Co Ltd on Tuesday signed a syndication loan for $113.1 million with three commercial banks to finance its factory construction.
The lead arrangers were Industrial Bank of Japan, Bangkok Bank Plc and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, BTSE Elastomer said in a statement.
BTSE Elastomer's major shareholders are Bangkok Synthetic Co Ltd with 60 percent stake, Japan Synthetic Rubber Co Ltd with 14 percent and Nippon Zeon Co Ltd with 12 percent, it said.

The company's plant, under construction at an industrial estate in eastern Rayong province, will have annual production capacity of 100,000 tonnes of synthetic rubber. The plant is scheduled to come on stream in 1998, it said.
